remarks: Beautiful ranch-style 1-bedroom unit located in a well-maintained complex. The kitchen features Corian countertops, white cabinetry, and ample space for cooking and entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom includes sliding doors that lead to a private deck. Enjoy a large living and dining area with freshly cleaned carpets. Additional features include an attached one-car garage and a separate storage unit. The complex offers beautifully landscaped grounds and a community pool. Conveniently located close to shopping, restaurants, and the train, making it an ideal location for easy living. Note: The blue door to the left-when on the front steps leads to the garage. Go down the staircase make right garage door on left side use key to get into garage. Take keys with you from front door it unlocks the door that gets you into garage.
